t: Fortress Trade Decking Oil is a solvent-based wood treatment designed to protect and enhance outdoor timber decking. Ideal for maintaining the longevity and appearance of garden decking, this oil provides essential protection against the elements. It protects weathered timber from drying and splitting, ensuring wood remains healthy and strong. The formula offers excellent water repellence and replaces natural oils, helping to prevent moisture damage. Its clear finish enhances the natural beauty of all wood types, making it suitable for professionals seeking reliable decking care. A 5Ltr jerry can covers approximately 30 square metres and is touch-dry in 2-4 hours, allowing for efficient application.
